caption: The drawing shows a transparent glass vessel with two handles, rendered in shades of light blue, turquoise, and gray. The vessel has a rounded, bulbous body that narrows slightly at the top, with a thick opening and a spherical object resting inside, partially emerging above the rim. Each side features a curved handle that extends outward and then hooks downward, connecting to the vessel at two points on each side. The vessel sits on a circular, ribbed pedestal base, which is colored in deeper blue and green tones. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with minimal shading or additional elements.
title: Sugar Bowl
